What it is

A repeatable system for cinematic AI commercials.

Most AI video tools give you one clip at a time, and every clip looks like a different world. This system is built for the harder thing: multi-shot commercials where the same character, the same product and the same visual world hold across every cut.

You direct the scene in one line of shorthand. The system turns it into a fully structured, timestamped prompt with camera moves, lighting and physical sound design, attaches the right references, and renders it on Seedance. It comes with a full worked example, a failure log of every content-filter trap and its fix, and four built-in skills that carry you from idea to finished shot.

How it works

Idea to finished commercial, in one loop.

1

Load your project

Drop in your brand, product, characters and locations. Fill the template brief once. It becomes the single source of truth every prompt reads from.

2

Build clean references

Generate white-background character and product sheets with the built-in skills, upload them, and log the IDs. These lock identity across every shot.

3

Direct in plain English

Say what the shot does in one line. The system writes the full multi-shot prompt: cuts, camera, light, and material sound design, following every rule in the kit.

4

Preview cheap, finish high

Fire a fast, low-cost preview to check identity and composition, then render the final at full quality. The failure log keeps you off the content-filter traps.

5

Log, iterate, ship

Approved prompts and failed prompts both get logged, so every project makes the next one faster and cheaper. Cut the clips together and deliver.

Questions

Before you buy.

Do I need a Higgsfield account?

Yes. The system is built for Higgsfield and its models (Seedance 2.0 and 2.5, Nano Banana, GPT Image 2). You bring your own account and credits. The method, prompts and skills work on any account; the reference IDs are generated on yours.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. You direct scenes in plain English and the system writes the prompts. There is an optional command-line path for scripted batches, but it is not required to get results.

Will my characters be perfectly consistent?

Consistency is the hardest problem in AI video, and no tool solves it completely yet. This system makes it dramatically more consistent with far fewer regenerations, using reference stacks, character sheets and a tested workflow. Every film on this page held its car, character or product across every cut using this method.

What do I actually receive?

A complete project folder: the template docs, four Claude skills, the failure log, a complete worked example project with its references, prompts, settings and final film, eight starter environment descriptors, a quickstart guide, and a one-page cheat sheet. Instant download after checkout.

Do I need Claude?

Yes. The system runs on Claude: the four skills, the prompt writing and the project management all happen in Claude Code or the Claude desktop app, so you need a Claude subscription alongside your Higgsfield account. If you already use Claude, there is nothing extra to set up beyond opening the folder.

What is the refund policy?

This is a digital download, so under EU consumer law you agree at checkout that delivery starts immediately and the 14-day withdrawal right ends once you download. If a file is broken, missing or does not match what this page describes, write to me and I will fix it or refund you.

Are there updates?

Yes. AI video moves fast, so the system carries a last-verified date and you get future updates to the kit free.
